decisive_spans.text: continuous anterior chest pain exacerbated by deep breathing
minimal hyperintensity of pericardium without effusion

response.rationale: D6 (Myopericarditis) is strongly supported by both myocardial and pericardial involvement, as evidenced by elevated troponin, hypokinetic left ventricle, and pericardial inflammation. D3 (Myocarditis) is also supported by the cardiac findings but does not account for the pericardial involvement.
